title.narrative: Nature-based Solutions Support Network Philippines (NbS SN): Transdisciplinary Forum on Nature-based Solutions 2026

description.narrative:
Forest Foundation Philippines, in support for the Nature-based Solutions Support Network (NbS SN), has committed to building the knowledge base on the intersections among biodiversity, climate, gender, and nature-based solutions (NbS) for climate adaptation, by organizing platforms for co-creation and knowledge exchange on NbS, and building communities of practice on NbS at local and national levels.
In response, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) is leading the institutionalization and mainstreaming of NbS in national policies and broader implementation, in collaboration with development partners, non-government organizations (NGOs), civil society organizations (CSOs), and the academe. This multistakeholder group has formed the Nature-based Solutions (NbS) Support Network. The Foundation has and continues to support the DENR and the network in this effort, to help organize meetings among the partners and contribute to policy development.
On September 9-10, 2025, the Foundation and its partners at the NbS SN organized PUNLA: A Multistakeholder Forum on Nature-based Solutions (NbS). The Forum was presented by Forest Foundation Philippines, the Government of Canada, DENR, and the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN), in collaboration with UPLB Forestry Development Center (FDC), Philippine Red Cross, and WWF-Philippines. The Asia Foundation, Wetlands International Philippines, Global Mangrove Alliance Philippines, Energy Development Corporation, and the International Institute of Rural Reconstruction also supported the Forum.
While the Forum contributed to bridging the knowledge gaps on NbS, it also revealed prevailing questions and challenges, such as the relationship between NbS and nature-positive outcomes, the lack of locally documented examples of high-integrity NbS implementation, and the call for national standards on NbS to guide local implementers.
The feedback on the Forum was overwhelmingly positive, exceeding the expectation of participants both in-person and online. Interest to join in the Forum was also much higher than the organizers anticipated, a clear indication of the increasing attention to NbS and the importance of platforms for exchange. It is thus important to keep this momentum going, with a view to expanding the scope of the discourse and level of participation.
In line with the success of "Punla", a second national-level NbS Forum will be held over 2-3 days in June 2026. NbS Forum 2026, in line with the targets of the PCP4NbS program and the goals of the NbS Support Network, will build on the results of PUNLA to strengthen high-integrity implementation and institutionalization of NbS in the Philippines, by showcasing examples and improving discussions while ensuring a transdisciplinary approach.
